en: Black‑and‑white image of a large ivy‑covered manor house set in a meadow with scattered flowers and framed by trees. The central building has a tiled hip roof with dormer windows and a classical pediment over the main façade. A stairway leads up through a landscaped lawn. A national flag flies on a tall pole above the house; the flag appears to be the blue‑and‑yellow Scandinavian cross of Sweden.
